name: Raycasting from the eye
summary: A ray that starts at the eye and is aimed by the orientation of the wrist or controller.
howItWorks: The ray origin is placed at the eye, so what the ray hits matches what the user sees, while the hand only sets its direction.

review.notes: Checked against Argelaguet & Andujar (IEEE CG&A 2009) in Oct 2026: the ray starts at the eye, its direction follows the hand's orientation (6-DoF Wanda in a CAVE), and a feedback ray is drawn from the hand. Outperformed classic ray casting in sparse and cluttered scenes.
